name: Band Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Stand on one end of a resistance band with one or both feet and grip the top loop behind your head with both hands.
Point your elbows straight upward beside your ears, brace your core, and keep your rib cage stacked down.
Extend both elbows smoothly upward until your arms reach full lockout directly overhead.
Lower your hands slowly behind your head into a full triceps stretch while keeping your upper arms vertical.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing up and relatively close together rather than flaring wide to the sides.
Avoid overarching your lower back as band tension increases toward overhead lockout.
